answer: Macrophages are present from early gestation onward (the innate immune compartment, including macrophages and ILCs, was already present from early gestation, in contrast to B and T cells which emerged later around 10 PCW); the prenatal skin dataset itself spans 7-17 PCW.
support_quote: Innate immune cells, such as macrophages and innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), were present from early gestation, whereas B cells and T cells emerged later, accompanying thymus, bone marrow and spleen formation from around 10 PCW
